args.evidence: stg_orders model filters out recent orders using `where o_orderdate < (select max(o_orderdate) from raw.orders) - interval 7 day`. Raw orders count is 15000, but stg_orders has 14941 rows, missing the latest 59 orders. This causes the freshness check to see 1 stale row and the relationship check to report 230 orphan lineitem rows (lineitem rows reference order keys that were filtered out). The filter is unnecessary/incorrect, so fixing the model (removing the date filter) will restore the missing orders and resolve both failing checks.
